prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, Night, warm sconce light on the elevator landing.
Image 1: the character sheet of Lu Shaoze (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S3
Image 3: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S2
Image 4: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 10: the prop grocery bag full of greens; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Camera on the front-wall side of the landing, facing the autumn landscape painting on the back wall. Ji Ran stands beneath the painting on its elevator side, arms folded, facing the walnut front door. Lin Qingyu stands close beside her, nearer the console table, his arm no longer around her, the grocery bag full of greens in his left hand. Lu Shaoze stands one pace in front of the walnut front door, facing them, fists clenched. The brushed-steel elevator doors are closed.
Panel 1: Medium shot, handheld camera, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door. Lu Shaoze shakes his head hard and thumps his own chest, glaring at Ji Ran.
Panel 2: Medium shot, dirty single, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting. Ji Ran rolls her eyes and tilts her head beneath the painting, arms still folded, a sliver of Lin Qingyu's shoulder at the frame edge.
Panel 3: Close-up, clean single on Ji Ran's face and shoulders, push in, eye level, from the front-wall side. Ji Ran lifts her chin and gives a dry, provoking half-smile toward the front door.
Panel 4: Medium shot, tracking with Lin Qingyu from beneath the painting toward the walnut front door, eye level, from the front-wall side. Lin Qingyu steps across the stone floor until he stands in front of Lu Shaoze and peers at his face with fake concern, the grocery bag in his left hand.
Panel 5: Medium shot, two-shot in profile, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting. Lin Qingyu pats Lu Shaoze's shoulder twice with his right hand, smiling innocently. Lu Shaoze stiffens, his back to the front door.
Panel 6: Close-up insert on Lu Shaoze's shoulder, locked-off camera, eye level. Lu Shaoze knocks Lin Qingyu's hand off his shoulder with a swipe.
Panel 7: Medium shot, low angle, handheld camera, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door. Lu Shaoze points furiously from Lin Qingyu to Ji Ran, his face red, his mouth opening and closing without a word.
Panel 8: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the stone-corridor end facing the painting. Lu Shaoze turns on his heel and strides across the open stone floor past Ji Ran to the brushed-steel elevator doors. He jabs the button and storms in, and the doors close behind him. Lin Qingyu steps back beside Ji Ran beneath the painting.
Panel 9: Medium shot, two-shot composition, slow push in, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting. Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu turn their heads and exchange a look beneath the painting. Ji Ran's arms loosen.
Panel 10: Close-up, clean single on Lin Qingyu's face, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side. Lin Qingyu breaks into a wide, mischievous grin.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
